title: S08T04 - Generate or round-trip runtime schemas from TypeScript contracts
description: Replace or augment hand-written schema checks with generated schema/validator parity.
acceptanceCriteria: Every published schema ID has a matching validator and test.
closedReason: S08T04 acceptance met: every published schema file is bound to a validator/test contract, and schema drift now fails CI through registry/file/ID/validator parity tests.
